replay_method: Re-derive the one-force and equal-color-pair constructions directly from the exact Paper-II axioms (i)-(iv), the source partition definition, and the already sealed dynamic-to-Y0-component uniformity. Do not reuse the primary proof wording as an assumption.

i.single: G and X0 are unchanged, so the truth value is unchanged.
i.pair: G and X0 are unchanged, so the truth value is unchanged.

ii_connected.derived_fact: Every u in X union Y has a neighbor in S, because axiom (iii) makes Y0 exactly the vertices outside S union X0 anticomplete to S.
ii_connected.single: Adding u attached to S preserves connectedness.
ii_connected.pair: Adding u and v, each attached to S, preserves connectedness even though uv is a nonedge.

ii_no_complete.source: No vertex outside S is complete to S.
ii_no_complete.single: A vertex outside S union {u} complete to S union {u} would be complete to S.
ii_no_complete.pair: A vertex outside S union {u,v} complete to the enlarged seed would be complete to S.

iii.source: Y0=V(G) minus (N(S) union X0 union S).
iii.single_set_identity: V(G) minus (N(S union {u}) union X0 union (S union {u})) = Y0 minus N(u).
iii.pair_set_identity: V(G) minus (N(S union {u,v}) union X0 union (S union {u,v})) = Y0 minus (N(u) union N(v)).
iii.why_no_new_residual_vertices: Every old non-Y0 vertex outside S union X0 already belongs to N(S).

component_integrity.single: For each connected old Y0 component C, u is complete or anticomplete to C. Hence either all of C is deleted from Y0 or all is retained.
component_integrity.pair: A component is retained exactly when both u and v are anticomplete to it; otherwise the whole component is deleted.

iv.source: No vertex outside Y0 union X0 is mixed on an edge of Y0.
replay_cases: Old outside-Y0/non-X0 vertices: old axiom (iv) applies to every retained edge because retained edges are old Y0 edges.
Newly seeded vertex or vertices: retained components are anticomplete to each forced vertex.

Old Y0 vertices moved out of the residual: each lies in a whole removed old component; distinct old connected components have no edges between them, so it is anticomplete to the retained component containing the tested edge.

single.properness: c in A(u) excludes conflicts with already fixed neighbors.
single.normal_subcase_syntax: Empty deletion set; S only grows by u from X union Y; X0 unchanged; f only extends by u->c.
single.extension_equivalence: Extensions of the new state are exactly extensions of P with u=c.

pair.properness: c lies in both exact palettes and uv is a nonedge, so assigning c to both is proper.
pair.normal_subcase_syntax: Empty deletion set; S grows by u,v from X union Y; X0 unchanged; f extends by the two assignments.
pair.extension_equivalence: Extensions of the new state are exactly extensions of P with u=v=c.

R2_replay.identity: Existence of an extension of P with u=v=c is equivalent to existence of an extension of the u=c forced state with v=c.
R2_replay.algorithmic_firewall: No recursive algorithm follows until B2B1 proves that the forced state returns to an authorized R1 class or terminates.
